What must the Article 53(1)(c) copyright compliance policy contain, in particular how it must identify and respect text-and-data-mining opt-outs under Article 4(3) of Directive (EU) 2019/790, and how does the GPAI Code of Practice copyright chapter operationalise this?

According to the JECFA 96th meeting (2023) summary report and toxicological monograph (WHO Food Additives Series / TRS), how did JECFA evaluate the same human epidemiological studies, including NutriNet-Santé and the artificially-sweetened-beverage/liver cancer studies? On what grounds did JECFA judge the evidence of an association between aspartame and cancer not convincing?

HNSW 인덱스에서 메타데이터 필터와 결합할 때 결과 누락이 발생하는 구체적 조건(pre-filtering vs post-filtering)은 무엇인가?
What does the European Commission's official template for the Article 53(1)(d) public summary of training content require, when was it published, and how detailed must the summary be?

How does Article 113 of the EU AI Act set the dates of application for Chapter V (GPAI obligations) and for the penalty provisions? How do Articles 113 and 111(3) together create the 2025, 2026 and 2027 timeline for GPAI providers?
What methodological or framework differences explain why IARC and JECFA reached different weightings of the same underlying studies (hazard identification vs. risk assessment approach)?

For each study, what concrete limitations did IARC identify, such as exposure assessment via beverage intake rather than aspartame specifically, residual confounding by diabetes or obesity, reverse causation, and small numbers of cases?

What do JECFA's own procedural documents (e.g., WHO Technical Report Series, JECFA procedures manual) state about how risk assessment and ADI derivation methodologically differ from hazard identification?

Did the WHO itself, as an organization (separate from IARC as a specialized agency), formally classify aspartame as carcinogenic? What official public health messaging did the WHO issue in July 2023 (e.g., statements by the Director of Nutrition and Food Safety) regarding consumption advice?

두 시스템의 하이브리드 랭킹 제어 수단은 어떻게 다른가? 점수 융합 방식(RRF, 가중 선형 결합, 점수 정규화), 부스팅, function/script score, rescoring, Learning-to-Rank, 시맨틱 리랭커(text_similarity_reranker)를 비교한다. PostgreSQL에서 SQL로 직접 구현하는 융합·재정렬의 표현력과 한계도 다룬다.

What exactly did IARC conclude about aspartame in 2023, according to the IARC Monographs Volume 134 summary published in The Lancet Oncology (July 2023) and the official IARC/WHO press release? Examples include the GPAI guidelines (July 2025), the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, the training-data summary template, and the AI Office FAQ.

PostgreSQL 17은 하이브리드 검색에 어떤 기능을 제공하는가? 코어 전문검색(tsvector/tsquery, GIN/GiST 인덱스, ts_rank/ts_rank_cd)을 확인하고, 코어가 아닌 확장 pgvector의 벡터 기능(vector/halfvec/sparsevec 타입, HNSW·IVFFlat 인덱스, 거리 연산자, 필터링·iterative index scan)을 구분해 정리한다. 두 기능을 단일 SQL 쿼리에서 결합하는 공식 권장 패턴도 PostgreSQL·pgvector 공식 문서와 릴리스 노트 기준으로 조사한다.
